## Context / Problem

The scheduled **Test Suite (mirror)** workflow (`.github/workflows/test.yml`) fails on every scheduled run (latest checked: run 41638314556, 2026-11-03 04:44 PST, sha `e1c9eb09fa3`). The failing probe was added when the reconciler moved to `rebar.reconciler` (commit `1b8c50e3c23`, 2026-10-20); scheduled runs were already red before that date, so other failures predate it. In 5 scheduled runs checked (2026-11-01 to 2026-11-03: 41338211499, 41503532529, 41555561498, 41591840011, 41638314556) the macOS leg shows the same 9 failures each time. Two gating sweep legs install rebar **non-editable** (`uv pip install '.[...]'`, test.yml lines 318 and 347):

- `sweep (macos, full suite)`: 9 failed, including 3 in `tests/unit/test_engine_dir.py` (the direct probe, the nested probe, and the `test_test_suite_store_isolation.py` parametrization that re-runs the nested probe).
- `sweep (declared lower-bound resolution)`: 3 failed, the same 3 and nothing else.

Failure: `AssertionError: rebar.reconciler.classify resolved to /Users/runner/work/rebar/rebar/.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/rebar/reconciler/classify.py`.

## Root cause (reproduced)

`tests/unit/test_engine_dir.py:157` (`test_reconciler_submodules_resolve_to_the_package_source`) computes the expected location as `REPO_ROOT / "src" / "rebar" / "reconciler"`. That is where the package lives only under an **editable** install. Under a non-editable install the package correctly lives in `site-packages/rebar/reconciler/`, so the assertion fails even though the import is right. The test's stated intent (its docstring) is that the submodule is the package's own file and never a same-named test-tree module (`tests/unit/reconciler/classify/`). The checkout path is an editable-only proxy for that.

Local reproduction: a non-editable venv (`uv venv --python 3.13` + `uv pip install '.[dev]'`) fails both `test_reconciler_submodules_resolve_to_the_package_source` and `test_engine_submodules_resolve_from_a_tests_unit_module`; the editable worktree `.venv` passes both.

This is the same class as the closed bug `anatomical-arbored-oyster` (change 2420): tests that derive install-specific paths fail on the non-editable legs.

## Approach

Anchor the expected directory on the imported `rebar` package itself: `Path(rebar.__file__).resolve().parent / "reconciler"`. That is the package's real reconciler directory under every install layout, and a test-tree module (under `tests/`) can never be inside it, so the guard keeps its purpose. Only the test changes; no product code changes.

Add a regression test that fails on the current code in the ordinary editable `.venv`, so the class is caught by the gating cell and not only by the scheduled sweep: copy `src/rebar` (without `__pycache__`) into `tmp_path/site/rebar`, run a nested pytest (`tests/_nested_pytest.py::run_nested_pytest`) selecting the probe with `PYTHONPATH=<tmp_path/site>` (PYTHONPATH entries precede the editable `.pth` entry on `sys.path`), and assert it passes. Before that, assert in the same env that `rebar.__file__` resolves inside the copy, so the test proves it actually exercised a relocated package. No autouse fixtures and no new `tests/_*.py` helper module.

## Scope

- `tests/unit/test_engine_dir.py`: change the expected-directory anchor; add the relocated-package regression test.

## Testing

- RED: the new regression test fails on the current anchor in the editable `.venv`.
- GREEN: after the fix, the new test and both existing probes pass in the editable `.venv`, and both existing probes pass in the non-editable scratch venv.
- `tests/unit/test_test_suite_store_isolation.py` passes (it re-runs the nested probe).
- `make lint` and `make typecheck` pass with the worktree `.venv/bin` first on PATH.

## Out of scope

The 6 `tests/unit/test_review_bot*.py` lifespan failures on the macOS leg (`AttributeError: 'State' object has no attribute 'config'`) are a separate defect with a different cause, filed as `vegetarian-rainy-darwinsfox` and linked `discovered_from`. Until that lands the macOS leg stays red, so these criteria judge this defect by its own failures.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The new relocated-package regression test in `tests/unit/test_engine_dir.py` fails before the fix and passes after it, in the editable worktree `.venv`.
- [x] Under a non-editable install (`uv pip install '.[dev]'`), `pytest tests/unit/test_engine_dir.py` passes.
- [x] `make lint` and `make typecheck` exit 0.
- [x] [non-codebase] The change is merged through Gerrit with `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`. Gerrit change 3268, revision 94ee4ed65e954fd71cd2f03eaccb50b5ff019467 voted LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 with 0 unresolved comments; merged 2026-11-03 07:54 PST as 1f71e4f84ade1c94b5e83b80976a5ffeacc171d1.
